# Taqueria Sabrina

> Taqueria Sabrina is a Mexican food pop-up (taquería mexicana) based in Utrera, Spain — in the province of Seville (Sevilla), Andalusia. We serve authentic, freshly made Mexican tacos at pop-up events around the area, with vegan and gluten-free options.

## About

Taqueria Sabrina is a mobile taco stand bringing real Mexican street food — tacos — to Utrera and the surrounding Sevilla region of southern Spain. Everything is made fresh at each pop-up. We rotate a weekly selection of tacos and specials, with vegan, vegetarian, and gluten-free options available.

Cuisine: Mexican food, tacos, Mexican street food (comida mexicana, tacos, taquería).
Location: Utrera, Sevilla, Andalucía, Spain.
Dietary options: vegan (vegano), vegetarian (vegetariano), gluten-free (sin gluten).
Language: primarily Spanish (español).

## The deal

Tacos are priced as a bundle: 1 taco for €3, 2 tacos for €5, 3 tacos for €7.

## Menu

The taco menu changes week to week. Typical offerings include tacos such as Tortillero, Adobada, Tinga, and BBQ, plus à la carte specials like pinchitos and guacamole. Check the website or Instagram for the current menu, prices, next event date, and location.
